protocol: M145/M148-style independent randomized-Haar cross-reference risk screen

separation_from_existing_protocol.rule: This is a new protocol. It neither replaces nor edits the sealed two-stream 1e9-path protocol.

estimand.network_law: the same 24 generated width-256, depth-32, bias-free ReLU networks and network/setup seeds frozen by the sealed protocol
estimand.per_output_target: I_j(W) = E_x[f_j(x;W)] for x distributed N(0,I_256)
estimand.exact_radialization: I_j(W) = rho256 * E_u[f_j(u;W)], u uniform on S^255, by positive one-homogeneity

reference_rule.name: independently Haar-rotated 126-basis antipodal Kerdock reference
reference_rule.basis_selection: the 126 Hadamard/Kerdock phase bases with phase indices 2 through 127; no coordinate basis
reference_rule.point_law: for every fixed unit design line d, Qd and -Qd are evaluated, where Q is a fresh Haar draw on O(256); each point is marginally uniform on S^255 although points within one reference are deliberately dependent
reference_rule.haar_construction: draw a 256x256 float64 standard-normal matrix, compute QR, and multiply each Q column by sign(diag(R)), taking sign(0)=+1; do not force determinant +1
reference_rule.estimate: R_j = rho256/(2*32256) * sum over design lines d of [f_j(Qd;W)+f_j(-Qd;W)]
reference_rule.forward: direct, unpruned, unfurled evaluation of all 32 affine/ReLU layers; no candidate fold, rescue, tangent, analytic closure, learned proposal, or shared estimator state
reference_rule.accumulation: evaluate float64 unit directions with the frozen float32 weights interpreted as exact input constants; accumulate each 256-vector by deterministic pairwise float64 reduction
reference_rule.unbiasedness_scope: The randomized cubature identity is exact for the mathematical fixed network. The implementation must report float64 numerical diagnostics separately; floating-point roundoff is not asserted to be stochastic or exactly unbiased.
reference_rule.independence: R1 and R2 use distinct rotations and RNG instances and are independent of each other, the network generator, the candidate/comparator setup RNGs, and estimator execution/timing. The same realized R1,R2 pair is reused for A and B.

reference_assets.asset_use_limit: The listed source is provenance only. A new standalone direct-reference evaluator must be implemented and independently audited before execution; candidate estimator code may not be reused in the reference path.

reference_replicates.canonical_seed_table_encoding: UTF-8 lines 'network_index|pair_index|r1_rotation_seed|r2_rotation_seed\n' in lexicographic network_index then pair_index order, including the final newline
reference_replicates.rng: a fresh NumPy PCG64 generator per recorded seed; no generator or QR factor may be reused across references
reference_replicates.theory_vs_prng: The proof treats the rotations as independent Haar variables. Seed-domain separation is the frozen deterministic implementation of that sampling assumption, not a cryptographic proof of independence.

cross_risk_statistics.per_pair_paired_difference: diff[i,k] = risk_A[i,k]-risk_B[i,k] using exactly the same R1_i_k,R2_i_k
cross_risk_statistics.network_aggregate: arithmetic mean over all eight pair replicates; retain every replicate
cross_risk_statistics.adjusted_difference: mult_A[i]*risk_A[i,k] - mult_B[i]*risk_B[i,k], where each multiplier is measured independently of the references and frozen before reference generation
cross_risk_statistics.algebraic_cancellation: diff = (||A||^2-||B||^2-(A-B) dot (R1+R2))/256; the R1 dot R2 term cancels exactly
cross_risk_statistics.finite_sample_sign: risk_A, risk_B, their network means, and bootstrap draws may be negative. Never clip, truncate, absolute-value, winsorize, replace, or discard them.
cross_risk_statistics.nonfinite_rule: any nonfinite prediction, reference, dot product, multiplier, or bootstrap statistic invalidates the complete screen

conditional_unbiasedness_proof.conditioning: Fix W and A, and condition on any candidate randomness and multiplier values. Let delta=A-I, R1=I+e1, R2=I+e2.
conditional_unbiasedness_proof.assumptions: E[e1|W]=E[e2|W]=0; e1 and e2 are conditionally independent; both are independent of A and B given W.
conditional_unbiasedness_proof.result: E[dot(A-R1,A-R2)/256 | W,A] = ||A-I||^2/256 because both linear terms have zero mean and E[e1 dot e2|W]=0.
conditional_unbiasedness_proof.paired_result: Applying the identity to A and B with the same references gives E[diff|W,A,B]=MSE(A|W)-MSE(B|W). Multiplication by reference-independent frozen cost multipliers preserves unbiasedness for the adjusted-risk difference.
conditional_unbiasedness_proof.random_estimator_extension: If A or B is randomized, take the outer expectation after conditioning on its realized output; reference independence is mandatory.

variance_identity.absolute: For conditional reference covariances Sigma1,Sigma2, Var(risk_A|W,A) = [delta^T(Sigma1+Sigma2)delta + tr(Sigma1 Sigma2)]/256^2 when the two reference errors are independent.
variance_identity.paired_difference: For Delta=A-B, Var(diff|W,A,B) = Delta^T(Sigma1+Sigma2)Delta/256^2; the tr(Sigma1 Sigma2) cross-product variance is removed by shared references.
variance_identity.interpretation: The paired difference is the primary inferential statistic. Absolute cross-risk is retained because it is unbiased but can be noisier and negative.

design: asset SHA-256 values match before any reference is generated
all 126 bases have 256 unit rows and the frozen phase-index selection
antipodal closure contains exactly 64512 evaluations per reference
float64 QR orthogonality and row-norm defects are recorded; any defect above 2e-12 invalidates the screen
independence: all 384 rotation seeds are unique and match the canonical seed-table hash
reference seeds are disjoint from network/setup/truth/bootstrap seeds
R1 and R2 rotations and buffers are generated in separate processes or separately initialized RNG instances
neither estimator can access a reference vector, seed, QR factor, or partial reduction before its prediction is hash-sealed
numerics: direct float64 forward only, pairwise float64 accumulation, and no fast-math contraction whose behavior is unrecorded
for the first network and first pair, a second independently coded direct evaluator must agree within 2e-11 relative RMS and 2e-10 maximum absolute output
reference outputs, code/runtime versions, seeds, counts, and SHA-256 values are retained
estimator: candidate and comparator retain the same frozen network/setup coupling, replay, memory, cost, and failure gates as the sealed protocol
any post-outcome parameter change, network filtering, seed substitution, retry replacement, or hidden pilot invalidates the screen

reference_diagnostics.retain: all R1 and R2 256-vectors and all eight risk_A, risk_B, raw diff, and adjusted diff values for every network
replicate_checks: per-network R1-R2 RMS and maximum component difference for every pair
between-pair variance and covariance of absolute and paired risk statistics
leave-one-pair-out network means for k=0 through 7
counts and locations of negative finite absolute-risk estimates
R1/R2 output hashes, rotation hashes, design hash, and seed/hash independence checks
reference_diagnostics.no_posthoc_response: large variance or negative estimates may make the result ambiguous, but cannot justify adding replicates, changing the rule, clipping, or rerunning this frozen cell for promotion

joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.network_resampling: sample 24 network indices with replacement in every draw
joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.reference_resampling: within each selected network occurrence, sample eight of its pair indices with replacement and average them
joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.coupling: use the identical sampled network occurrences and pair indices for candidate, comparator, raw difference, adjusted difference, and all ratios
joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.primary: bootstrap the ensemble mean paired adjusted-risk difference
joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.ratio_rule: ratios are formed only from aggregate bootstrap mean risks, never from per-network or per-pair ratios. If any comparator aggregate denominator is nonpositive, ratio-based promotion is ambiguous and fails; values are not clipped.
joint_hierarchical_bootstrap.absolute_rule: bootstrap the candidate ensemble mean adjusted cross-risk using the same hierarchical draws

promote_only_if_all: every joint-bootstrap comparator adjusted-risk denominator is positive
candidate adjusted cross-risk upper-90 < 2.05e-7 sealed M71 proxy
zero failures and every asset, direct-forward, independence, replay, numerical, resource, and coupling gate passes
predeclared_decision.otherwise: retain M145 as a failed or ambiguous recursive component; do not call it effective, winning, ranked, submitted, or promoted, and do not tune this frozen cell from its outcomes

compute_feasibility.memory_plan: stream one 256-line basis and its antipodes at a time through two float64 activation buffers; never materialize 64512x256x32 activations
compute_feasibility.scope: reference generation is offline validation compute, not part of either submitted estimator and not charged to its contest score; wall time and storage must be dry-run audited before authorization
compute_feasibility.comparison: This is about 24.8 million full-network reference paths across the campaign, far below the sealed 48 billion truth paths, but it remains a substantial approximately 103.9-teraflop dense campaign before overhead.

firewall: No reference evaluator has been implemented or run; no network output, reference output, truth, MSE, risk, adjusted score, rank, leaderboard row, submission, designation, champion replacement, or efficacy outcome is authorized or present.
